name: Teguise and Mirador del Río
description: The compact northern classic from Teguise: the Tabayesco valley climb and the cliff-edge finish at Mirador del Río with views to La Graciosa. 67 km.

name: Costa Teguise to Mirador del Río
description: 80 km from Costa Teguise through Teguise and the Haría valley to the island's northern tip and back — the standard Lanzarote north loop.

name: Northern Lanzarote Big Loop
description: The full north from Puerto del Carmen: Tabayesco, Mirador del Río and the wild west coast return. 92 km of everything Lanzarote does best.

name: El Golfo and La Geria Loop
description: 65 km through the black-ash vineyards of La Geria to the green lagoon at El Golfo and the southern volcanic coast — the island's signature scenery.

name: La Geria and Janubio Salt Flats
description: From Playa Blanca through the wine country to the Janubio salt flats — 70 km of rolling volcanic roads with barely 750 m of climbing. Wind is the difficulty here.

name: La Geria and Timanfaya Loop
description: 77 km from Costa Teguise across the island to the edge of Timanfaya's volcanic badlands and back through La Geria — smooth tarmac through fields of lava.

name: Timanfaya and Femés 100
description: 101 km around the south: the Timanfaya volcanic park, the Femés climb and the southern coast — Lanzarote's hard southern century.

name: Vuelta a Lanzarote
description: The island lap: 175 km around the whole of Lanzarote from Arrecife. The local rite of passage — start early and respect the wind.
